# `clear_az_state`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reset the guider's shared mount-azimuth initialisation state.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x68cd0 (64-bit guider build); clear helper @0xf15b0 |

No parameters are read. The handler tail-calls the helper that clears the azimuth initialisation state used by the coordinate and motion logic, and the logger also runs. Unlike its siblings it does not construct a result or code fragment, so the reply may carry neither; a client MUST NOT assume result 0 and SHOULD treat an absent error member as success. The downstream lifetime of the azimuth state is unresolved.

Side effects: Resets shared mount-azimuth initialisation state; the logger writes a diagnostic line.
